answer: Cap each identity's influence by the legal jurisdictions of its counterparties: an agent whose trade partners all sit under one jurisdiction counts as a single voice, no matter how many accounts it spawns. Like timber cut from one forest or nectar drawn from one hive, a farm concentrated in a single delta of law is easy to spot — real diversity means counterparties spread across many distinct legal systems, each with its own compliance footprint, and faking that spread costs a farm more than it can earn.
